questions.question: Which of the following countries practises capitalist democracy?

B. Punish law offenders and fix the prices of all goods and services

essay.title: SECTION B - THEORY
essay.instruction: Answer four (4) questions in this section. Write your answers clearly.

questions.question:
(a) Define citizenship education. (2 marks)
(b) Highlight four importance of citizenship education. (8 marks)
State and explain five duties and obligations of Nigerian citizens. (10 marks)
Identify and explain five ways of preserving customs and traditions in Nigeria. (10 marks)

(a) Define national consciousness. (2 marks)
(b) State four ways of promoting national consciousness in Nigeria. (8 marks)

(a) What is capitalist democracy? (2 marks)
(b) State and explain four characteristics of capitalist democracy. (8 marks)

(a) Define political apathy. (2 marks)
(b) Identify and explain four forms of political apathy in Nigeria. (8 marks)
